gen-fs-gambarino-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans draws every stroke as a single smooth line, with curve endings kept well apart and a precise, modern feel. Gambarino sits above it, heavy and dramatic, with hairline whiskers that look crisp against the sans below.
gen-fs-gambarino-satoshi: Gambarino swells its curves heavy and then tapers them to nothing, giving the heading a dramatic, high-contrast look against its moderate lowercase height. Satoshi runs tall and open, every stroke cut to one width.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-merriweather-san: Tall lowercase makes every word in Merriweather Sans look sturdy and large, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Snowburst One plays the stencil showman above it, wide bridges between letters, while the sans below stays tidy and neutral.
gen-syne-noto-serif: Noto Serif moves with a subtle thick and thin cadence, its strokes gently tapered and its x-height prominent. And Syne, the experimental heading, keeps its terminals at constant width, so a page reads literary below and blunt above.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-ranade: Expressive and bold, Revalia strides across widely separated letters, with a lowercase g that leaves its lower curve open. Ranade, the plain sans below, lets its stroke weight ebb and flow gently, and it can take a generous size.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-merriweather-sans: Bold and tube-like, Tilt Neon pours constant-width strokes into curves with no stress and a splayed c terminal. Merriweather Sans answers with low-stress, tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy, and that sturdiness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-ranade: Wire-bent and a bit odd, Tektur gives every curve a generous terminal opening and keeps its strokes at constant thickness. But Ranade, the sans-serif body, does the gentler work, with a mellow range of stroke weights and stroke ends set far apart.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-rhodium-libre: Rhodium Libre reads editorial and traditional, its brush ends lifted away before each curve closes. Chubbo, drawn as if with a marker tip, adds a casual heading above, so a long page feels like a conversation with a polished text serif.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-fs-asap: Asap reads open and readable, with c forms like easy arcs and a body height nearly matching its capitals. Pramukh Rounded shares that build, bunched tight and friendly, so the two feel like close relatives rather than strangers.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-fs-bespoke-slab: Pramukh Rounded packs its glyphs tight, with open bowls tipped toward you and large lowercase forms, giving the heading a friendly, neutral face. Bespoke Slab follows with tall, grounded text serif lowercase that stays refined.
